text:
Ravi: Heads-up, Zenith POC is getting 429s during preflight imports to /v1/embeddings.batch. They're running their importer as a ramp (10 -> 50 threads) and hit failure at ~11:10 PT. Need quick triage before the Friday demo.

Eve: Ask for sample request sizes + client retry pattern + which model variant. Also confirm tenant id.

Ravi: Customer info: tenant zenith-poc-3, model embed-xlarge, importer reported batches of 256, then increased to 1024 as they ramped. Client retries every 100ms without jitter.

Kai: That explains it. Short retries + ramp = thundering herd. Send any server 429 body they captured.

Ravi: Snippet they pasted:

```

HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
{"error":"rate_limit","retry_after_ms":1500,"route":"/v1/embeddings.batch","tenant_id":"zenith-poc-3","tokens":98000}
```

Eve: Retry-After 1500ms but client retries at 100ms—will keep retrying and pile up. Two options: ask customer to pause and fix client backoff, or apply a short per-route bump to finish import.

Nora: Customer wants the import finished today for demo. Approve a short bump if infra recommends safe limits.

Kai: I can apply a 40-minute override: tokens_per_min=350000 for /v1/embeddings.batch on zenith-poc-3, and enable a soft concurrency cap=8 to avoid overwhelming downstream. I'll need an ack here to proceed.

throttle-bot: [automated] Override API: POST /internal/admin/overrides {"tenant_id":"<id>","route":"<route>","tokens_per_min":<n>,"concurrency_limit":<m>,"duration_min":<d>} 1 infra approval required for concurrency changes.

Ravi: Approved. Please apply and share override id.

Kai: Applied ov-20260326-22 at 11:15Z. tokens_per_min=350000, concurrency_limit=8, duration_min=40.

throttle-bot: [automated] Override ov-20260326-22 applied for tenant zenith-poc-3 by Kai. Scheduled end 11:55Z.

Ravi: Told customer to resume at 11:20 and to stop ramping beyond the declared concurrency. Also sent a one-line client fix: replace fixed 100ms retry with exponential backoff+full jitter (base=300ms,max=4s) and honour Retry-After.

Eve: For post-demo follow-up we should give them an embeddings batching recommendation: 1) batch size 128, 2) concurrency 4-6 for embed-xlarge, 3) consider streaming inserts if available. I'll add this to the POC playbook.

Nora: Noting temporary concession in CRM. Will schedule a technical handoff to implement client backoff and a permanent quota adjustment if they need it.

Kai: Monitoring now. No new 429s after resume. I'll revert override 10m before scheduled end to test.

throttle-bot: [automated] Override ov-20260326-22 scheduled end 11:55Z.

Ravi: Demo run at 11:35 reported successful. Customer accepted guidance and will patch the importer tomorrow.

Eve: I'll attach a short code sample for jittered backoff to the POC repo and notify SEs.

Kai: Reverted override at 11:50Z; no regressions. Closing monitor window at 12:00Z.

Ravi: Thanks team. Lesson: always ask about ramp patterns + retry strategy on preflight imports.
